name: GNU units
author: Adrian Mariano, Russ Rogers and the Free Software Foundation
description: GNU units converts between more than 3000 units of measure and computes with them: lengths, speeds, energy, cooking, temperatures, currencies, chemical elements. Type units '5 mph' 'km/hr', or units for the interactive prompt.
usage: units -t 'FROM' TO (result only) | units 'FROM' 'TO' | units (prompt). Hours are hr (h = Planck), temperatures tempC(37) tempF tempK, compute: units -t '230 V * 10 A' kW. Currency rates are from Nov 2024.

descriptions.en: GNU units converts between more than 3000 units of measure and computes with them: lengths, speeds, energy, cooking, temperatures, currencies, chemical elements. Type units '5 mph' 'km/hr', or units for the interactive prompt.
descriptions.it: GNU units converte tra oltre 3000 unità di misura e ci fa i calcoli: lunghezze, velocità, energia, cucina, temperature, valute, elementi chimici. Scrivi units '5 mph' 'km/hr', oppure units per il prompt interattivo.

does.en: Converts and computes with 3000+ units of measure. Hours are hr, temperatures tempC(37). Run: units -t '5 mph' 'km/hr' | units -t 'tempF(100)' tempC (currency rates are old)
does.it: Converte e calcola con oltre 3000 unita' di misura. Ore = hr, temperature tempC(37). Uso: units -t '5 mph' 'km/hr' | units -t 'tempF(100)' tempC (tassi di cambio vecchi)
